chunks: 967 - Abdullah ibn Jundab narrated from Musa ibn Ja‘far عليهما السلام that he said:

In the Sajdah of Shukr, you say: 'O Allah, I call You to witness, and I call Your angels, Your prophets, Your messengers, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, my Lord; Islam is my religion; Muhammad is my Prophet; and ‘Ali, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, Musa ibn Ja‘far, ‘Ali ibn Musa, Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, ‘Ali ibn Muhammad, al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali, and al-Hujjah ibn al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali are my Imams. Through them I profess loyalty, and from their enemies I dissociate. O Allah, I adjure You by the blood of the oppressed' three times. 'O Allah, I adjure You by Your pledge upon Yourself against Your enemies, that You most surely destroy them by our hands and the hands of the believers. O Allah, I adjure You by Your pledge upon Yourself for Your awliya’, that You most surely grant them victory over Your enemy and their enemy, and that You send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the entrusted ones from the family of Muhammad' three times.
And you say: 'O Allah, I ask You for ease after hardship' three times.

Then place your right cheek on the ground and say: 'O my refuge, when the ways leave me helpless and the earth, vast as it is, becomes constricted for me. O Originator of my creation, out of mercy toward me, while You had no need of my creation, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and upon the entrusted ones from the family of Muhammad' three times.
Then place your left cheek on the ground and say: 'O Humiliator of every tyrant, and O Giver of honor to every abased one, by Your might, I have reached the limit of my endurance' three times.

Then return to prostration and say one hundred times: 'Thanks, thanks.' Then ask for your need, if Allah wills. And do not perform the Sajdah of Shukr in the presence of an opponent, and employ taqiyyah in omitting it.

key_terms.أَئِمَّتِي: my Imams, referring here to the divinely appointed Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.أَتَبَرَّأُ: I dissociate myself and declare disavowal
key_terms.التَّقِيَّةَ: precautionary dissimulation for protection in hostile circumstances
key_terms.الْمَظْلُومِ: the one who has been wronged or oppressed
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحْفَظِينَ: those entrusted with preservation from the family of Muhammad
key_terms.سَجْدَةِ الشُّكْرِ: the prostration of gratitude performed in thanks to Allah

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in Sajdah of Shukr according to Imam Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the supplication and manner of performing Sajdah of Shukr, combining testimony of faith, allegiance to the Imams عليهم السلام, prayers for relief, and intimate du'a to Allah. It also includes a legal caution to observe taqiyyah and refrain from performing this prostration openly in the presence of opponents.
